channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Midday Markdowns
channel.desc: Glow up for less with Beauty Midday Markdowns! Discover top beauty picks at irresistible prices, perfect for refreshing your routine and treating yourself to something special.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Reset Your Wellbeing
channel.desc: Reset your wellbeing with inspiring tips and products designed to help you feel your best. Discover easy ways to boost your mind, body and daily routine.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Tweak'd By Nature Haircare
channel.desc: Discover revolutionary haircare formulas from Tweak'd using luxurious ingredients from around the world, including kauri amber resin from New Zealand, dhatelo oil from Nepal, and more.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Pai Skincare on Free Delivery
channel.desc: Discover results-driven, organic skincare from the experts at Pai, all with FREE delivery! That's right, there's no P&P to pay on these luxurious skincare treats, so snap them up before they go.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Beauty Steals and Deals
channel.desc: Love beauty? Tune in to see the latest deals and bag a beauty bargain. We've got an exciting array of popular and iconic brands plus cult products you're sure to adore.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Laura Geller Make-up
channel.desc: Laura Geller is a renowned make-up artist, teacher and working mother and the creative force behind one of the most successful make-up studios in New York. Join us to explore her superb range.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: skinSense by Abi Cleeve
channel.desc: Bringing together the latest, ground-breaking technology with the highest grade concentration of unique active ingredients, discover long-lasting skincare with anti-ageing benefits from skinSense.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Liz Earle Naturally Active
channel.desc: Liz Earle is an award-winning British beauty brand renowned for creating naturally active skincare and bodycare products, which help to deliver real results for all ages and skin types.

channel.name: QVC Beauty UK
channel.title: Tarte Cosmetics
channel.desc: This show features high performance natural products from Tarte Cosmetics, including everything from Amazonian clay to maracuja oil. Find a wide variety of glamorous eco-chic products you'll love.
